title: Perturbation-resilient inertial Krasnosel'skii-type hybrid retractions for generalized nonexpansive mappings
summary: Let $\E$ be a uniformly smooth and uniformly convex real Banach space. We study an inertial hybrid retraction method for a countable sequence of mappings satisfying the NST-condition and an approximate $φ$-Fejér inequality with vanishing errors. We prove that the generated sequence converges strongly to the sunny generalized nonexpansive retraction of the initial point onto the common fixed-point set.
